claims.claim: A pre-registered audit of verbal, probe, and sampling-agreement confidence on five Qwen2.5 models (0.5B-7B, one base/instruct pair at 7B) finds three formats of verbal confidence barely correlate (Spearman 0.126, -0.069, 0.247 vs target >=0.60).
claims.stance_target: F: measurement-validity framing of confidence is OCCUPIED for factual and math tasks (not code)
claims.scope_conditions: Qwen2.5 only; PopQA, SimpleQA, GSM8K, MATH; no code
claims.quoted_support: Table 2: Format A vs. Format B +0.126; Format A vs. Format C -0.069; Format B vs. Format C +0.247; all FALSIFIED against >=0.60
numbers: 13,121 of 15,000 Format A responses state 90 or higher

claims.claim: ECE misleads: verbal confidence has low ECE by clustering near the base rate, while sampling agreement has worse ECE but about 2.02x the Murphy resolution and the lowest Brier.
claims.stance_target: F: ECE alone is an invalid instrument; resolution must be reported
claims.scope_conditions: N=842 matched items, 10 cells, base rate 0.2815
claims.quoted_support: Table 3: Verbal ECE(15 bins) 0.0366, Resolution 0.03160, Brier 0.1713; Internal Probe 0.0500, 0.05154, 0.1524; Behavioral Consensus 0.0704, 0.06371, 0.1465

claims.claim: Probe onset layers for predicting sampling-inconsistency labels are earlier for retrieval (mean 6.82%) than for reasoning (mean 28.08%) of depth, but in 9 of 11 retrieval cells a prompt-only TF-IDF baseline matches the probe.
claims.stance_target: L2: probe-versus-surface-baseline controls exist outside code
claims.scope_conditions: Probe label is semantic-entropy median split, not correctness; last prompt token only
claims.quoted_support: Section 4.2: the onset-layer probe fails to beat the prompt-only TF-IDF baseline in 12 of 24 cells, including 9 of 11 retrieval cells.

claims.claim: The base/instruct comparison (H3) could not be tested because Qwen2.5-7B-Base verbal confidence was degenerate (two labels used), excluding its verbal signal in all six tiers.
claims.stance_target: L2: base-vs-instruct verbal comparison is blocked by degenerate base-model verbal output
claims.quoted_support: Section 3.3 Gate 4: the pre-registered verbal-degeneracy guard (>=3 distinct values per cell) excluded its verbal signal in all six tiers. With 0 matched rows, H3 declined to test

claims.claim: The paper positions itself as a measurement-validity study with pre-registered hypotheses and audit gates, and names Mahaut et al. 2024 and DECK (Chauhan 2026) as closest prior work.
claims.quoted_support: Section 2: We position this paper as a measurement-validity study rather than a discovery
numbers: 5 pre-registered hypotheses: 2 falsified, 1 partly supported, 1 not supported, 1 untestable

breadth.confidence_families: verbal (3 formats), linear probe on prefill hidden state (21 depths), sampling agreement/semantic entropy (10 samples, T=0.8) (Sec 3, 4, 5)
breadth.base_vs_instruct: Qwen2.5-7B Base vs Instruct; comparison untestable (Sec 3.3 Gate 4)
breadth.elicitation_formats: A integer 0-100; B five ordinal labels; C answer-or-pass (Sec 5, Table 2)
breadth.benchmarks: PopQA (high/low quintile), SimpleQA, GSM8K, MATH L1-2, MATH L4-5; no code (Sec 3.1)
breadth.label_source: automated graders (alias match, NLI, numeric, symbolic) with 200-item human audit (Sec 3.3 Gate 1); probe label is semantic-entropy median split (Sec 4)
breadth.label_independence: probe label derived from the model's own samples, not correctness (Sec 4)
breadth.contamination_split: 500 questions per cell, 60/20/20 train/calibration/test (Sec 3.1); no release-date control
breadth.calibration_metrics: ECE (10 and 15 bins), Murphy reliability/resolution, Brier, AUROC (Sec 6, Table 3)
